Players Committee card image of [[Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm (V) (ALT) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “'''Light Side:''' Anakin, Beru and Owen may move to or from here for free when using landspeed.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/tatooinelarsmoisturefarm_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6cae8c9ca0ffa879985fee5c01eca246364add0d 6cae8c9] (20 January 2026). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the latest version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
